posts.text:
✅ The Senate has CONFIRMED Todd Blanche as Attorney General. I was proud to vote in support of his confirmation. 

@DAGToddBlanche has worked diligently at the DOJ for many months to crack down on crime and keep communities safe across the nation. I know he will continue to do that as AG.

posts.text:
While Senator Lindsey Graham may not have been physically on the Senate floor today to witness the passage of the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act, his presence and legacy were unmistakable.

Today, the Senate stood firm for peace through strength and for everything Lindsey fought tirelessly for. Now, we’ll work diligently to get this legislation through the House and onto President Trump’s desk.
